# API reference

> Caligrafy Quill 2.25.0: every public class, method and helper function of the framework, generated from the source at each release by `php qa/build-api-reference.php`. Each method shows its signature, its doc comment as written in the code, its parameters, what it returns and the line of the source it is on.

The guides of the wiki explain how to use these classes; start with [How Caligrafy works](https://github.com/caligrafy/caligrafy-quill/wiki/How-Caligrafy-Works).
